kurz: Store crisp and soft biscuits separately and airtight: moisture always moves from moist to dry.
bild_im_kopf: Like two rooms with the door open: the moisture spreads until both are the same.
was_passiert: Sugar draws in moisture. If soft and crisp biscuits share a tin, the soft ones give up water: they turn hard and the crisp ones turn soft. An airtight tin keeps the moisture where it is.
warum_wichtig: Stored properly, most biscuits keep two to three weeks, gingerbread considerably longer (as a guide).
faustregeln: Crisp with crisp, soft with soft.
schritte: Let biscuits cool completely, or steam condenses in the tin.
Each kind in its own tight-fitting tin.
Store soft biscuits and gingerbread with an apple slice, changing it every few days.
Keep somewhere cool, but not in the fridge.
